topics.title: The Dark Reason Bruce Wayne Refused to Kill
topics.hook: Bruce Wayne refused to execute a criminal for the League of Shadows, but not out of mercy.
topics.core_thesis: Bruce realized that the moment a vigilante crosses into execution, justice becomes tyranny and fear becomes oppression.

topics.title: Why Bruce Wayne Weaponized His Childhood Fear
topics.hook: Batman was built from the very thing Bruce Wayne feared most.
topics.core_thesis: Bruce does not overcome his fear of bats; he masters what fear does to the human psyche and weaponizes it into an immortal symbol.

topics.title: Why Tony's Nanotech Suit Consumes His Clothes
topics.hook: When Tony tapped his reactor, the nanotech vaporized his sunglasses and jacket.
topics.core_thesis: Driven by severe PTSD, Tony designed the Mark 50 to consume whatever fabric he was wearing into raw carbon plating to deploy defense in milliseconds.

topics.title: The Exact Second Cap Became Worthy
topics.hook: Did Cap suddenly become worthy in Endgame, or did he fake it in Age of Ultron?
topics.core_thesis: Worthiness is binary. The second Mjolnir budged in Age of Ultron, Steve stopped pulling to spare Thor's pride in front of the Avengers.

topics.title: The Secret Meaning of the Ticking Clock on Miller's Planet
topics.hook: Every tick in Hans Zimmer's soundtrack is exactly 1.25 seconds apart.
topics.core_thesis: Because 1 hour on Miller's planet equals 7 Earth years, each 1.25-second tick represents an entire 24-hour day passing on Earth.
